@concat('Select ', string(variables('li_Batchid')), '" as Batchid, SBSB_ID,GRGR_ID,CSCS_ID,BLEI_CK, BLBL_DUE_DT,BLBL_END_DT, BILLEDAMT, RCVDAMT, NET_DUE, TOL_BILLEDAMT, BLDF_MCTR_STMT, DELINQ_LETTER_DT, BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND, BLBL_PAID_STS, BLEI_BILL_LEVEL,BILL_MODE
			,RUNDATE, PROC_DATE, TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(BLBL_DUE_DT,1) )||''/16/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(BLBL_DUE_DT,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') as GRACEEXPDTE,CURR_MOD ,'''' as FAMLLNK,GRACEPERIOD,
			BLEI_NET_ALLOC_SUSP,BLDF_EFF_DT,BLDF_TERM_DT,BLDF_BL_TYPE,BLBL_DAYS_BILLED,BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST,CURR_MCTR_STMT,MEEL_ELIG_TYPE,MEEL_VOID_IND,bldf_tol_pct as Tol_Percentage,'''' AS FAMILYLINK_BGBG_ID
			From (
			SELECT
			31 AS GRACEPERIOD
			,BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE as NET_DUE
			,BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT AS BILLEDAMT
			,BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT as RCVDAMT
			,case when (EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT)-EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_END_DT))=0 THEN cast(BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT*0.9 as decimal (10,2)) else cast((BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT/blbl.BLBL_DAYS_BILLED)*30 as decimal (10,2)) end as TOL_BILLEDAMT
			,BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL AS BLEI_BILL_LEVEL
			,SYSDATE as RUNDATE
			,(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT +14) as DELINQ_LETTER_DT
      ,SUBSTR( bldf.bldf_tol_pct, 1, LENGTH( bldf.bldf_tol_pct) - 4) as BLDF_TOL_PCT
			,BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT as BLDF_MCTR_STMT
			,BLDF2.BLDF_MCTR_STMT as CURR_MCTR_STMT
			,BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND as BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND
			,BLBL.BLBL_PAID_STS as BLBL_PAID_STS
			,BLDF.BLDF_MODE as BILL_MODE
			,BLDF2.BLDF_MODE as CURR_MOD
			,MEPE.CSCS_ID as CSCS_ID
			,GRGR.GRGR_ID as GRGR_ID
			,SBSB.SBSB_ID as SBSB_ID
			,BLEI.BLEI_CK as BLEI_CK
			,BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT as BLBL_DUE_DT
			,BLBL.BLBL_END_DT as BLBL_END_DT
			,TO_DATE(''"', variables('ls_processDate'), '"'',''YYYY-MM-DD'') AS PROC_DATE
			,BLEI.BLEI_NET_ALLOC_SUSP as BLEI_NET_ALLOC_SUSP
			,BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT as BLDF_EFF_DT
			,BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT as BLDF_TERM_DT
			,BLDF.BLDF_BL_TYPE as BLDF_BL_TYPE
			,BLBL.BLBL_DAYS_BILLED as BLBL_DAYS_BILLED
			,BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST as BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST
			,MEEL.MEEL_ELIG_TYPE,MEEL.MEEL_VOID_IND
			FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR
			JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB  ON     GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE ''CASUP%''
			JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM SBSP ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSP.SBSB_CK and to_date(''"', variables('ls_processDate'), '"'',''YYYY-MM-DD'') Between SBSP.SBSP_EFF_DT and SBSP.SBSP_TERM_DT
			JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD  ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSD.SBSB_CK AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP NOT IN (''FAML'', ''EMPL'') and SBSP.SBSP_EFF_DT = SBSD.SBSP_EFF_DT
			JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK  AND MEME.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK
			JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG mepe   ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = ''Y'' AND TO_DATE(''"', variables('ls_processDate'), '"'',''YYYY-MM-DD'') Between MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT and MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
			JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI  ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = ''I'' AND BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> ''D''
			JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF    ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLDF.BLEI_CK
			JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK And BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT Between BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT and BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT
			Join FACETS.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF2    ON BLDF.BLEI_CK = BLDF2.BLEI_CK AND BLDF2.BLDF_MCTR_STMT NOT IN (''FAML'', ''EMPL'') AND TO_DATE(''"', variables('ls_processDate'), '"'',''YYYY-MM-DD'') between BLDF2.BLDF_EFF_DT AND BLDF2.BLDF_TERM_DT
			JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS ON MEPE.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID
			JOIN CMC_MEEL_ELIG_ENT MEEL ON MEEL.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK AND To_date(''"', variables('ls_processDate'), '"'',''YYYY-MM-DD'')  > MEEL.MEEL_EFF_DT
			WHERE BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT < BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT
			And MEEL.MEEL_INSQ_DT = (Select MAX(MEEL2.MEEL_INSQ_DT) From CMC_MEEL_ELIG_ENT MEEL2 where MEEL2.MEME_CK = MEEL.MEME_CK and MEEL2.MEEL_VOID_IND = ''N'')
			) where BLBL_DUE_DT+GRACEPERIOD <= To_date(''"', variables('ls_processDate'), '"'',''YYYY-MM-DD'')
			Union ALL
			Select "', string(variables('li_Batchid')), '" as Batchid, SBSB_ID,GRGR_ID,CSCS_ID,BLEI_CK, BLBL_DUE_DT,BLBL_END_DT, BILLEDAMT, RCVDAMT, NET_DUE, TOL_BILLEDAMT, BLDF_MCTR_STMT, DELINQ_LETTER_DT, BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND, BLBL_PAID_STS, BLEI_BILL_LEVEL,BILL_MODE
			,RUNDATE, PROC_DATE, TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(BLBL_DUE_DT,1) )||''/16/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(BLBL_DUE_DT,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') as GRACEEXPDTE,CURR_MOD, FAMLLNK,GRACEPERIOD,
			BLEI_NET_ALLOC_SUSP,BLDF_EFF_DT,BLDF_TERM_DT,BLDF_BL_TYPE,BLBL_DAYS_BILLED,BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST,CURR_MCTR_STMT,MEEL_ELIG_TYPE,MEEL_VOID_IND,bldf_tol_pct as Tol_Percentage,FAMILYLINK_BGBG_ID
			From (
			SELECT
			31 AS GRACEPERIOD
			,BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE as NET_DUE
			,BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT AS BILLEDAMT
			,BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT as RCVDAMT
			,case when (EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT)-EXTRACT (MONTH FROM  BLBL.BLBL_END_DT))=0 THEN cast(BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT*0.9 as decimal (10,2)) else cast((BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT/blbl.BLBL_DAYS_BILLED)*30 as decimal (10,2)) end as TOL_BILLEDAMT
			,BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL AS BLEI_BILL_LEVEL
			,SYSDATE as RUNDATE
			,(BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT +14) as DELINQ_LETTER_DT
      ,SUBSTR( bldf.bldf_tol_pct, 1, LENGTH( bldf.bldf_tol_pct) - 4) as BLDF_TOL_PCT
			,BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT as BLDF_MCTR_STMT
			,BLDF2.BLDF_MCTR_STMT as CURR_MCTR_STMT
			,BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND as BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND
			,BLBL.BLBL_PAID_STS as BLBL_PAID_STS
			,BLDF.BLDF_MODE as BILL_MODE
			,BLDF2.BLDF_MODE as CURR_MOD
			,MEPE.CSCS_ID as CSCS_ID
			,GRGR.GRGR_ID as GRGR_ID
			,SBSB.SBSB_ID as SBSB_ID
			,BLEI.BLEI_CK as BLEI_CK
			,BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT as BLBL_DUE_DT
			,BLBL.BLBL_END_DT as BLBL_END_DT
			,To_date(''"', variables('ls_processDate'), '"'',''YYYY-MM-DD'')  AS PROC_DATE
			,BLEI.BLEI_NET_ALLOC_SUSP as BLEI_NET_ALLOC_SUSP
			,BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT as BLDF_EFF_DT
			,BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT as BLDF_TERM_DT
			,BLDF.BLDF_BL_TYPE as BLDF_BL_TYPE
			,BLBL.BLBL_DAYS_BILLED as BLBL_DAYS_BILLED
			,BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST as BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST
			,BMFLY.FAMILYLINK_ID as FAMLLNK
			,MEEL.MEEL_ELIG_TYPE,MEEL.MEEL_VOID_IND
      ,BMFLY.FAMILYLINK_BGBG_ID
			FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR
			JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB  ON     GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE ''CASUP%''
			JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM SBSP ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSP.SBSB_CK and To_date(''"', variables('ls_processDate'), '"'',''YYYY-MM-DD'')  Between SBSP.SBSP_EFF_DT and SBSP.SBSP_TERM_DT
			JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSB.SBSB_CK=SBSD.SBSB_CK AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP=''FAML'' AND SBSD.SBSD_SPLT_PCT = 1000000 and SBSP.SBSP_EFF_DT = SBSD.SBSP_EFF_DT
			JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK  AND MEME.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK
			JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG mepe   ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = ''Y'' AND To_date(''"', variables('ls_processDate'), '"'',''YYYY-MM-DD'')  Between MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT and MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
			JOIN FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG ON SBSD.BGBG_CK=BGBG.BGBG_CK
			JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI ON BGBG.BGBG_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = ''B'' AND BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> ''D''
			JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF    ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLDF.BLEI_CK and BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT  = ''FAML''
			JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK And BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT Between BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT and BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT
			Join FACETS.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF2    ON BLDF.BLEI_CK = BLDF2.BLEI_CK AND BLDF2.BLDF_MCTR_STMT  = ''FAML'' AND BLDF2.BLDF_MCTR_STMT NOT IN (''EMPL'') AND To_date(''"', variables('ls_processDate'), '"'',''YYYY-MM-DD'')  between BLDF2.BLDF_EFF_DT AND BLDF2.BLDF_TERM_DT
			JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS ON MEPE.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID
			Join BILLING_MDSUPP_FAMILY BMFLY On (SBSB.SBSB_ID = BMFLY.SUBSC_HCID or SBSB.SBSB_ID = BMFLY.DEP_HCID) and BMFLY.SUB_GRGR_ID = GRGR.GRGR_ID
			JOIN CMC_MEEL_ELIG_ENT MEEL ON MEEL.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK AND To_date(''"', variables('ls_processDate'), '"'',''YYYY-MM-DD'')  > MEEL.MEEL_EFF_DT
			WHERE BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT < BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT
			And MEEL.MEEL_INSQ_DT = (Select MAX(MEEL2.MEEL_INSQ_DT) From CMC_MEEL_ELIG_ENT MEEL2 where MEEL2.MEME_CK = MEEL.MEME_CK and MEEL2.MEEL_VOID_IND = ''N'')
			)  where BLBL_DUE_DT+GRACEPERIOD <= To_date(''"', variables('ls_processDate'), '"'',''YYYY-MM-DD'')
			Order by SBSB_ID,BLBL_DUE_DT"')

@concat('Select ', string(variables('li_Batchid')), '" as Batchid, GRGR.GRGR_ID, SBSB.SBSB_ID, BLEI.BLEI_CK,BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT,BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE,BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT,BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT,BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT,BLBL.BLBL_END_DT FROM

			,BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT as BLDF_MCTR_STMT 			,BLDF2.BLDF_MCTR_STMT as CURR_MCTR_STMT 			,BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND as BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND 			,BLBL.BLBL_PAID_STS as BLBL_PAID_STS 			,BLDF.BLDF_MODE as 			,BLBL.BLBL_END_DT as BLBL_END_DT 			,To_date('2017-10-2','YYYY-MM-DD')  AS PROC_DATE 			,BLEI.BLEI_NET_ALLOC_SUSP as BLEI_NET_ALLOC_SUSP 			,BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT as BLDF_EFF_DT 			,BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT as
